title: TransCo to Mindoro consumers: Avoid unnecessary power consumption

blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The National Transmission Corporation (TransCo) said that households and businesses in Mindoro can help manage electricity supply amid a possible strong El Niño by cutting down on unnecessary power use, especially during the dry season when hydropower output may drop. TransCo President and Chief Executive Officer Atty. Joseph Omar Castillo
